name: Errant
description: Parnesse's wife and fiance, daughter of Anhelo.

description_citations.text: "Parnesse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the eve of his daughter's wedding, Anhelo takes Errant to a rundown neighborhood to buy information from Toluz.
timeline.quote: "Art's everywhere, if you know where to look,"

citation.work: The Family Man
citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo reaches the bridal suite in time and is reunited with Errant on her wedding day.
timeline.quote: "Daddy! Daddy, you're here!"

citation.work: The Family Man
citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: In a dream-memory of her wedding, Errant and Parnesse dance among the Maestros until Phyrexian oil transforms the guests, including her father Anhelo, and Atraxa tears off the roof.
timeline.quote: the roof of the Maestro's museum was ripped clean off

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant wakes in an abandoned station when a converter beast crashes through the wall, hunting her and Parnesse.
timeline.quote: The crash of a Phyrexian converter beast plunging through the wall had shattered their brief reprieve.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant and Parnesse flee over rails and ledges with stolen Riveteer explosives, using tagger's scrawl to find safe paths.
timeline.quote: The two heavy satchels that were laden with the explosives they had stolen from an old Riveteer's stash in the Mezzio clanked against her hips

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Cornered by two converter beasts, Errant and Parnesse choose to blow themselves up rather than be converted.
timeline.quote: "I love you until every canvas is filled."

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant wakes in the resistance hideout and learns Della healed them with Halo.
timeline.quote: Luckily, I was present to mend your wounds instantly

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Della says Halo cannot cure Phyrexianization but can prevent conversion.
timeline.quote: Halo can act as preventative against the conversion, but not a cure.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The team debates, and Henzie reveals the Riveteers found the city's core and plans to bring down Park Heights.
timeline.quote: There's a core to the city—think like a main support beam

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant agrees to place the charges after Parnesse insists on the choice, and the team explains Operation Falling Star.
timeline.quote: "The final stage: Operation Falling Star,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The team plans to lure Atraxa to the Nido sanctuary with Falco's trouble and angels, with Della to signal.
timeline.quote: "Then the lead cockroach herself might go to the Nido sanctuary to put an end to it,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The families rally; Falco's Brokers take position, Della rallies angels, and Parnesse shepherds citizens while Errant heads for the core.
timeline.quote: But, at last, they had worked out the final details.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Converter beasts chase the escaping citizens, and Errant uses Halo paint jars and her sprayer to defeat them.
timeline.quote: Paint sprayed out, swirling with the iridescent rainbows of the Halo with which it was infused.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant places the charges in the city's core and finds her Phyrexianized father Anhelo blocking her way.
timeline.quote: Her father stood before her.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Anhelo tries to persuade Errant to join New Phyrexia, and she argues beauty is mess and experimentation.
timeline.quote: "Beauty isn't found by coloring in the lines.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Della's Halo signal shows Atraxa is in position; Errant says goodbye to her father and detonates the core, collapsing Park Heights.
timeline.quote: The core above her burst with orange flame and smoke.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Della catches Errant as she falls from a missed jump and glides her to safety.
timeline.quote: Then, two sturdy arms wrapped themselves around her.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant reunites with Parnesse and her allies at the safe zone as the angels depart.
timeline.quote: "Parnesse!" Errant opened her arms just in time for Parnesse to throw herself into them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Fiero Vespin attacks Parnesse before her rehearsal dinner, breaking her ribs; she refuses to tell Errant.
timeline.quote: Fiero attacked Parnesse before their rehearsal dinner, leaving Parnesse with broken ribs and smelling of blood.

timeline.summary: Parnesse and Errant join the resistance against the Phyrexians; Parnesse is injured and healed by Della.
timeline.quote: but was later healed by Della and survived the invasion.
